semiconductor_relevance: High — EO Technics specializes in laser application equipment that is critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: EO Technics Singapore Pte, Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of laser application equipment, providing solutions for wafer grooving, dicing, drilling, and laser marking. Their products cater to various sectors including semiconductor, PCB, and flat panel display industries, ensuring high precision and efficiency.
capabilities: Wafer Grooving, Dicing and Drilling Machines
Laser Markers for SEMI and Non-SEMI applications
Laser PCB & Substrate Via Hole Drillers

regional_presence.Korea: EO Technics has its headquarters in Korea, focusing on the development of laser technology.
regional_presence.China: The company has a branch office in China to support its operations in the region.
regional_presence.Taiwan: EO Technics maintains a presence in Taiwan to cater to local market demands.
